name: Definitional Ambiguity in Machine Applied Rules
definition: A term carrying operational weight has no settled boundary, so automated application produces outcomes no party intended.
trigger_conditions: Rules are applied by code without a human interpretive layer
Terms are inherited from natural language instruments
No authority is named to settle meaning when application is contested
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F012 Definitional Ambiguity in Machine Applied Rules. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F012
